typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

srcType.description: The source type for this spec (e.g. the type on which `evalMetrics` will be called).

dataTimestamp.description:
The last time when data was persisted for this spec.
For a spec attached to an {@link MLTrainingJob} this timestamp reflects the time at which the job that persisted
the data completed. Note that there will not be any data associated with that instance of the spec, but rather
with the corresponding specs attached to all of the trained pipelines.
For a spec attached to an {@link MLPipeline} this timestamp reflects the actual time at which the data for that
was persisted as part of the training job.

title:
The base type for all data source specs for MLPipelines and MLPipelineTrainingJobs. The parametric binding `T` refers
to the data type produced by the spec.
name: MLDataSourceSpec
